facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports that the 2013 data protection law obliges organisations to declare processing to ARTCI or obtain authorisation, with fines for offenders.
facts.system: loi sur la protection des donnees personnelles de 2013

facts.fact: ARTCI is reported as the regulator handling complaints and inspections under the law.
ARTCI received 210 complaints and carried out 18 inspections, keeps the national file of data protection correspondents, and launched the Certinum online compliance platform on 2 July 2026.
